name: Distillates (petroleum), heavy hydrocracked; Baseoil - unspecified; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons from the distillation of the products from a hydrocracking process. It consists predominantly of saturated hydrocarbons having carbon numbers in the range of C15-C39 and boiling in the range of approximately 260 °C to 600 °C (500 °F to 1112 °F).]
